When the unit fights in close combat.
When the unit is selected as a target for a ranged weapon.
The unit receives +1 Initiative and -1 AP for its melee attacks.
The unit receives a +1 bonus to its armor save. (Can be combined with actual cover)
Hot-shot lasguns and lasguns change their type to "Rapid Fire 2".
All laser weapons in the unit receive the "Decimate" ability.
The unit swaps its command for "Advance" and rolls 2W6 for the additional movement, taking only the highest roll.
The unit can re-roll all wound and armor penetration rolls against Monstrous Infantry, Monstrous Creatures and Vehicles.

During the Rally phase. 

This order can be used by any unit, even if the order itself was not given during the prior Battle round, as long as there is at least one Officer on the table that is not fleeing. Reduce the amount of orders you may give in this round's Reinforcement phase by 1.
After the unit has used Defensive fire.
The unit can still fire all weapons after an "Advance" command as if it had used a "Move & Shoot" command.
The unit loses all Battle shock tokens.
The unit moves up to D6".
After the unit has used ranged weapons.
The unit can re-roll a single hit, wound or armor penetration roll.
The unit can use its smoke launcher even if it has fired its weapons this turn.

The unit can immediately shoot again with a Blast(x) or Auto Hit weapon. The target must be a mission objective marker. If the hit roll is successful, the opponent loses control of it if there are no more of his units on the mission objective.
The unit gains the "Decimate" ability with all weapons that have the "Auto Hit" ability.

The unit may target an enemy unit engaged in melee with a friendly unit. Any failed hit rolls are instead resolved as hits against the friendly unit. Weapons that have the "Blast(x)" ability can't be used. Weapons with the "Auto Hit" ability hit both the friendly and the enemy unit. In all cases, if more than one friendly unit is engaged, the friendly unit with the most models left is hit first.
When firing "Rapid Fire" weapons at a target within 12", the unit may choose which enemy model its ranged attacks are allocated to.
The unit can move up to 6", afterwards its order is changed to "Stand & Shoot".

The unit ignores the -1 to hit penalty when disembarking from a transport that moved 6"+. 

Alternatively, the unit may embark on a transport after using its ranged weapons. The alternative effect can only be used if the unit did not disembark during its activation.
If the unit uses a "Stand & Shoot" order, all ranged weapons in the unit gain the "Suppression(2)" ability.
